seed_rule: SHA256(b'oneq-heldout-2026||' + dataset + b'||' + commit)[:16] as an integer masked to 63 bits; the circuit rung additionally reduced modulo 2^31 - 1
why: The frozen runner reads its freeze commit with `git rev-parse held-out-freeze` and derives every seed from it. A public release carries no git history, so a reader who reproduces from the source snapshot needs the identity stated explicitly. tools/reproduce_heldout_public.py supplies THIS value to the frozen runner without editing a byte of it, and refuses if the snapshot does not verify against its manifest.
